item.title: Itawamba Community College President Dr. Jay Allen named finalist for national award

item.description: Bills that would authorize the state to seize the gambling earnings of those who owe child support have passed in both chambers of the Mississippi legislature. item.title: Mississippi Senate passes bill to require insurers to cover biomarker testing
item.description: The Mississippi Senate voted unanimously on Wednesday to require health insurers to cover biomarker testing – a technology that helps ensure cancer patients receive the most effective care – joining the House in approving similar legislation. item.description: The hits keep coming for Ole Miss, as the Rebels have now suffered six straight losses. item.title: T&L Extra: Former Diamond Dawg Luke Alexander Goes From Walk-Offs to Wardrobes
item.description: Luke Alexander’s legacy in Mississippi State baseball history is one of a player who found a way to come in the clutch when called upon. Brian Hadad welcomes the former Diamond Dawg to the pod to relive some great memories and discuss Alexander’s move into the sports apparel business.

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Predicting Mississippi State Baseball’s Starting Nine
item.description: Mississippi State announced the starting rotation for Opening Weekend, but we still don’t know who will be in the lineup. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk try to fill out the card before we learn Brian O’Connor’s first ever starting nine for the Diamond Dawgs.
